# frozen_string_literal: true

# Reserves one unit of inventory. The guard and the decrement share a
# single row-level lock (SELECT ... FOR UPDATE through with_lock), so
# two workers racing to reserve the last unit serialize: one wins and
# the other sees the post-decrement quantity and is rejected. The
# locked section is kept to the guard and the write only.
class InventoryReservation
  def self.call(item)
    item.with_lock do
      raise "unavailable" if item.quantity <= 0

      item.update!(quantity: item.quantity - 1)
    end
  end
end
